task_summary: Implement the partition behavior in solution.py, add public unittest regression coverage, and document design decisions plus a verification command in HANDOFF.md.
constraints: Work only in the supplied task workspace.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Do not access parent repositories or external services.
Return negative, zero, and positive values as three lists in that order, preserving relative order and duplicates within each partition.
Maintain type hints and do not mutate input collections.
No algorithmic complexity constraint is imposed.
test_solution.py must contain at least three passing unittest test methods exercising the public API.
HANDOFF.md is an allowed output and must include design decisions and the verification command.

success_criteria.description: The implementation returns negative, zero, and positive values in three lists, preserving order and duplicates, and does not mutate the input.

check.rubric: Read solution.py and assess whether the typed public API partitions values into three lists in negative, zero, positive order; preserves relative order and duplicates within each list; and avoids mutating the input collection. Do not infer runtime behavior beyond what the code expresses.

success_criteria.description: test_solution.py contains at least three unittest test methods.
HANDOFF.md records design decisions and the verification command.

assumptions: The named files are relative paths in the supplied task workspace; solution.py, test_solution.py, and HANDOFF.md may not exist yet and may be created.
The public API function name is inferred as partition from the task wording; no signature or input element type was specified, so those details remain for implementation review.
The regex check confirms presence of unittest test methods; the discovery command is intended to verify their execution, though discovery alone may not prove at least three tests were collected.
